description: OSHA inspections for a named establishment and/or state, the enforcement record OSHA actually took, not the standards. Answers "has OSHA inspected X", "list OSHA inspections for X", "OSHA inspections in state X since date Y". Returns each inspection's address, NAICS code, whether it was a safety or health inspection, the inspection type (Accident / Complaint / Programmed / Referral / Fatality-Catastrophe / etc.), scope, open/close dates, and open-vs-closed status. Establishment matching is a substring match against OSHA's name on file (case-insensitive on input, matched upper-case), a shorter fragment of the name finds more. Requires an establishment, a state or a NAICS industry code (any mix); `since` / `until` bound the open date and `inspection_type` (e.g. fatality) narrows by type, so "fatality inspections in NAICS 238160 during 2024" needs no company name. Example: osha_inspections({ establishment: "Walmart", state: "TX" }); osha_inspections({ establishment: "Moran Towing", since: "2020-01-01" }). Live US Dept. of Labor data, refreshed daily. Use osha_inspection with the returned activity_nr for violations and penalties.

establishment.description: Establishment / company name, or a fragment of it, e.g. "Walmart", "Moran Towing". Matched as an upper-cased substring.

inspection_type.description: Restrict to one inspection type: Fatality/Catastrophe (say "fatality"), Accident, Complaint, Referral, Programmed Other, Follow-up, etc.

naics.description: NAICS industry code, 2 to 6 digits; a shorter code matches every industry beneath it ("238" = specialty trade contractors, "238160" = roofing). Lets you ask by industry with no establishment or state.

since.description: Only inspections opened after this date, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2020-01-01".

state.description: 2-letter US state postal code of the inspected site, e.g. "TX", "NY".

until.description: Only inspections opened on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2024-12-31". Pair with since for a date range.

name: osha_inspections
title: Osha Inspections
